title: Seminar Tadarus 5T
lead: A public lecture introducing Tadarus of the Qur'an with the 5T method, delivered interactively — and practised together in circles.
whatsapp:
Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullah wabarakatuh.

I would like to ask about the Seminar Tadarus 5T.

audience.label: For
audience.value: Heads of institutions, preachers, Qur'an teachers & practitioners

general.title: General goals
items: Understanding the main purpose of studying the Qur'an.
Understanding the full meaning of the word "Tadarus".
Understanding the 5T method and the difference between Tafsir and Tadabbur.
Knowing the keys of tadabbur to draw lessons from a verse.
Understanding how to live a verse every day.

specific.title: Specific goal
items: Selecting participants for the ToT (Training of Trainers) programme.

topics.text: Main theme: Seminar Tadarus 5T, with these sub-themes:
items: Introducing the Qur'an Ambassador programme in Makkah

agenda: Session 2: The keys of tadabbur and 5T practice

method.title: How we learn
items: Questions and answers between speaker and participants.

funding.title: Costs
items: Transport, accommodation and learning materials are covered by the host.
Markaz Tadarus Indonesia welcomes infaq and sadaqah to support spreading Tadarus 5T.
